mechanism_candidate: Extreme signed funding may proxy crowded levered positioning vulnerable to reversal.
mechanism_problem: Funding is an endogenous basis-stabilization transfer, not a direct measurement of position fragility; its directional return implication is ambiguous.

prior_preregistered_evidence.funding_only_definition: positive funding and within-asset percentile rank >= 0.75
prior_preregistered_evidence.position: short perpetual for one official funding interval
prior_preregistered_evidence.derivation: crowding mean minus registered crowding-minus-funding-only incremental mean

literature.title: Funding Rate Mechanism in Perpetual Futures
What happens after extreme funding rates?

negative_tail_decision: Not isolated post hoc without materially new position or margin data and a novel mechanism.
reopening_rule: No changes to quantile, horizon, direction, costs or universe. Reopening requires materially new position/margin/liquidation data and a new preregistered mechanism.
